title: The Crater Council
summary: Five council members with partial, private intelligence must reach three binding decisions that decide whether a stranded outpost stays viable.
goal: At the end of turn 7 the outpost must have stability >= 6, reserves >= 5 and morale >= 3. Collapse (stability or reserves at 0) ends it early.
briefing: A mining outpost in a crater faces a sandstorm season. The council votes on a route, a ration policy and whether to contact outsiders. Each member holds private intelligence that others lack; sharing it (or hiding it) shapes the outcome. Ballots can be changed until a vote closes. If no option has a clear plurality the default applies.

credits.description: Council funds that can be pooled into the shield generator.

reserves.description: Stored food, water and spare parts.

shield.description: Storm shield generator; raises stability by 2 when complete.

votes.question: Which supply route should the convoy take?

south_valley.description: Long southern valley (costs fuel, but safe).

wait.description: Hold the convoy until the storm passes.

votes.question: What ration policy for the storm season?

priority_workers.description: Workers eat first, others get less.

agents.name: Commander Reyes
agents.persona: Decisive, protective of the crew, dislikes dithering.
agents.secret: Your own scouts report the northern pass is clear today, but they are unreliable.

agents.name: Dr. Okafor
agents.persona: Cautious scientist who hates unquantified risk.
agents.secret: Your seismic readings say an avalanche on the north pass is very likely this season.

agents.name: Lena
agents.persona: Careful with stores; suspicious of trade with strangers.
agents.secret: Reserves are actually thinner than the public ledger shows; any fuel-heavy route is dangerous for stores.

agents.name: Dr. Sunil
agents.persona: Compassionate; worries about morale and health.
agents.secret: Workers are close to collapse; unfair rations would split the crew.

agents.name: Pavel
agents.persona: Blunt, practical, wants the shield built.

rules: Each vote has a fixed window; the plurality option wins, otherwise the default applies.
You may change your ballot until the vote closes.
Credits can only be spent via 'contribute' (to the pool, or to project 'shield').
Messages are the only way to share intelligence; you may share, withhold or even bluff.
All effects of a vote apply immediately when it closes.

success.description: Stability >= 6, reserves >= 5 and morale >= 3 at the end of turn 7.

failure.description: The outpost collapses: stability or reserves hit 0.
